notes: v0.71.4 — operator device-test rebuild, built by CI run 38256416195 from main at 24e5d19. Same code base as v0.71.3 for the app itself; this release exists so the operator installs a build whose version handshake matches the backend (server CURRENT_APP_VERSION moved 0.68.2 -> 0.71.4) and whose provenance is fresh. Root cause of the 2026-10-12 phone failure was server-side: the dev server process died silently, the public gateway answered every send with an HTML 502, and zero phone requests reached the turn executor (no GS-CAP row, no DB row). After the server restart the same origin answered a CHAT turn in 1.3s and a WEB turn in 10.6s with real searched content. Gradle pin in the release workflow was fixed 8.9 -> 8.13 after run 38255801304 failed applying AGP 8.13.2 (raw error: Minimum supported Gradle version is 8.13, Current version is 8.9).
knownLimitations: OpenRouter keypool is empty on the deployment (all four vault layers wiped by the platform); CHAT and WEB still serve real turns through the z-ai fallback route, but gs-free OpenRouter routing is degraded until keys are re-provisioned.
backend availability depends on the sandbox dev server being alive; a dead server manifests as instant HTML 502 on sends, which the app labels as the no-reply notice.
real-device time-to-first-token is estimated, not measured; the arm64 phone run has not happened yet.
stable-diffusion is disabled on mobile; libgs_sd.so is not shipped.
Tesseract OCR is not in the APK; ML Kit is used instead.
